news.summary: Inspection of the factory premises and corporate head office by CSE
news.body:
A team of CSE visited the factory premises & corporate head office of Familytex (BD) Limited and found the operation/production closed. According to the documents received from Bangladesh Export Processing Zones Authority (BEPZA), all the assets of the Company inside BEPZA were sold out to M/s. Bangladesh Spinners & Knitters (Pvt.) Ltd. through a transparent and competitive public tender process due to prolonged operational suspension, ongoing financial deterioration, (cont.)

(Cont. News of FAMILYTEX): and failure to meet lease obligations and statutory liabilities of the Company. (end)

news.summary: Rounding of share prices in case of tick size adjustments
news.body: The Dhaka Stock Exchange PLC. (DSE) currently applies a tick size of BDT 0.10 for equity securities when determining single price deviations in the secondary market. After applying the parameters, the share price of Familytex (BD) Limited became unrounded due to the closing price calculation. In such cases, DSE shall round the share price to establish a reference price, ensuring the smooth movement of security prices.

news.summary: Revised Tick Size of BDT 0.01 Applied for the Company
news.body: The Dhaka Stock Exchange PLC. (DSE) introduced a revised tick size of BDT 0.01 for securities trading below BDT 1, effective from October 29, 2025. The market price of Familytex (BD) Limited has fallen to BDT 0.90, so a revised tick size of BDT 0.01 has been applied for the company, effective from today i.e., November 12, 2025.

news.summary: Rounding of share prices in case of tick size adjustments
news.body:
The Dhaka Stock Exchange PLC. (DSE) is pleased to announce that it currently applies a tick size of BDT 0.10 for equity securities when determining single price deviations in the secondary market. After applying the parameters, the share price of Fareast Finance & Investment Limited became unrounded due to the closing price calculation. (cont.)

(Continuation news of FAREASTFIN): In such cases, DSE shall round the share price to establish a reference price, ensuring the smooth movement of security prices. Thus, yesterday's Closing Price of BDT 1.01 has been rounded to BDT 1. (end)

news.summary: Implementation of Revised Tick Size for Equity Securities Below BDT 1
news.body:
(Continuation news of FAREASTFIN): from October 29, 2025, in accordance with Regulation 18 of the Dhaka Stock Exchange Automated Trading Regulations, 1999, to ensure smoother price discovery and improved market efficiency. (end)

The Dhaka Stock Exchange PLC. (DSE) is pleased to announce that DSE shall introduce a revised tick size of BDT 0.01 for securities trading below BDT 1, effective from October 29, 2025. The market price of Fareast Finance & Investment Limited has fallen to BDT 0.90. So a revised tick size of BDT 0.01 is applied for Fareast Finance & Investment Limited, effective (cont.)

news.summary: Investment in Premier LP Gas Limited by Omera Petroleum Limited
news.body:
The company has informed that Omera Petroleum Limited, a subsidiary of MJL Bangladesh PLC, has entered into an agreement to acquire 99.995% shares of Premier LP Gas Limited (PLPG), a leading LPG operator in Bangladesh under the brand name "Totalgaz Bangladesh". The consideration value of the proposed acquisition is BDT 227 crore, subject (cont.)

(Cont. news of MJLBD): to necessary regulatory approvals. The proposed acquisition is expected to strengthen Omera's LPG operations by utilizing PLPG's existing infrastructure and 1.6 million LPG cylinders, which in turn is anticipated to boost revenue and enhance profitability in the LPG business segment. (end)

news.body: The company has informed that it has expanded its presence in the European market by dispatching its first consignment of therapeutics to Portugal. news.summary: Renata PLC delivers Rivaroxaban Capsules to the Australian Market
news.body: The company has informed that it has successfully shipped its Rivaroxaban Capsules (15 mg and 20 mg) to Australia, marking the first availability of this important anticoagulant in capsule form in that market. The product has been manufactured at TGA-approved facility, underscoring Renata's commitment to meeting stringent global regulatory standards. This achievement not only broadens patient treatment options in Australia but also reflects Renata's steady progress in expanding its international footprint.

news.summary: Company launches first product in the Canadian pharmaceutical market
news.body: The company has informed that it has successfully launched its first product in the Canadian pharmaceutical market. The product, Desogestrel/Ethinylestradiol (0.15 mg/0.03 mg) tablets, is being commercialized under the brand names Miley 21 and Miley 28 through a strategic partnership with Ambicare Pharmaceuticals Inc., a well-established Canadian generic pharmaceutical company.

news.summary: Massive Fire incident occurred at Zaheen Spinning PLC.
news.body:
The company has informed that a massive fire broke out at Zaheen Spinning PLC. at Araihazar in Narayangonj at last night, Monday of 16th December 2024. The fire broke out at around 9.00 pm from electrical short circuit and engulfed the whole factory very quickly. Massive damage was done specially in Blow Room, Carding, Drawing, Simplex, Auto cone, AC Plant, Steel Building and Shed, warehouses etc. (cont.)

(Cont. news of ZAHEENSPIN): After 4 hours of relentless efforts, firefighters of three units of three fire stations doused the fire. The amount of damage done will be notified later on. Production operations have been completely shut down as most of the machineries were burned in the fire.
